description: Figure 7, titled "The evolution of KV caches in the streaming setting," presents two line plots that illustrate the dynamic behavior of key-value (KV) cache parameters over the number of tokens processed, denoted as `m` on the horizontal axis. The top plot shows the evolution of `n`, the number of active KV cache segments, which starts at 0 and increases linearly to `c - a` before resetting periodically at intervals of `m₀` tokens, forming a sawtooth pattern. The vertical axis is labeled `n`, with key reference lines at `0`, `w`, `c - a - s`, and `c - a`. The bottom plot displays the evolution of `Size_run`, the running size of the KV cache, which also starts at 0 and increases linearly to `w + a + s` before resetting periodically at the same `m₀` intervals, mirroring the sawtooth pattern of the top plot. The vertical axis for this plot is labeled `Size_run`, with reference lines at `0`, `c`, and `w + a + s`. Both plots share the same horizontal axis, `m`, which ranges from 0 to `m₀`, and demonstrate that both `n` and `Size_run` are periodic functions after `m₀` tokens, as noted in the accompanying text.
